title: Mixed Event — Tied By Painful Hope — Episode2 Pleased to Meet You, Ms. Songwriter!

meta.Episode: Episode2 — Pleased to Meet You, Ms. Songwriter!
meta.Event Outline: With their new outfits completed, MORE MORE JUMP! next gets someone to help create an original song for their next show. The composer gets to work, but then faces some troubles...

rows.Line: A few days later

rows.Speaker: Hasegawa
rows.Line:
<H-Hello...!
My name is Riho Hasegawa.
Thank you all for having me today!>

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
I'm Haruka Kiritani.
Thank you for sending us that email. We really appreciate your offer.

rows.Speaker: Hasegawa
rows.Line:
<No, I just...!
In any case, again, thank you!>

rows.Speaker: Hasegawa
rows.Line:
<*Sigh*
I still can't believe I get to write a song for MORE MORE JUMP!>

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
Hehe.
We're happy to hear that you're so excited about this.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
Still, you really took us by surprise.
Just as we were talking about our new song, your email pops into our inbox.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Yeah!
A few days earlier

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
What?!
Someone actually sent us an email saying they want to write a song for us?!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
Last night.
They even included a URL for another one of their songs, and I gave it a listen...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: What was it like?

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Hmm... How do I describe it...?

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: It might be quicker to just listen to it. Mind if I just play it right now...?

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Yeah, sure.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: I can't wait to hear what it's like.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: And play...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
Whoa...!
This song... It's dazzling...!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Yes, it's so bright and cheerful too!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: It's a little rough around the edges, but it's a great song! And it suits us so well as a group!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
I thought so too.
Not only that...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
I feel hope in this song.
I feel like I can keep going and try my best tomorrow...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
I say let's go for it.
I have a feeling this person can write the perfect song for us.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: This song even feels like it's worth covering too!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: I agree. Since we've reached a decision, let's ask this person, Hasegawa, about writing a song for us...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Also, I've come up with something in terms of how to compensate them. Mind telling me what you all think?

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Of course! Let's discuss that before classes begin!

rows.Speaker: Airi & Minori
rows.Line: “Yeah!”

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: We all really liked the song you sent us...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: I even went back to find your other videos and gave them a listen... Each song was so wonderful and they all felt like they were full of so much hope...

rows.Speaker: Hasegawa
rows.Line:
<Thank you very much...!
H-Haruka, I can't believe you're praising them like this...!>

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Huh?

rows.Speaker: Hasegawa
rows.Line:
<Oh no...! I-I'm so sorry, Kiritani!
The thing is... I've been a fan of yours forever...>

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Forever?

rows.Speaker: Hasegawa
rows.Line:
<Y-Yes...!
The way you said, “I'm here to give everyone hope for a better tomorrow!” was so cool...>

rows.Speaker: Hasegawa
rows.Line: <That was when I decided to start making songs that have the power to give all their listeners belief in a “better tomorrow”...!>

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: I see...

rows.Speaker: Hasegawa
rows.Line: <That being said, not many people are listening to my songs based on my videos' low view counts...>

rows.Speaker: Hasegawa
rows.Line: <Regardless... I still can't believe that you said you felt hope in my music, Kiritani!>

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
Now it makes sense...
In that case, please allow me to thank you.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: I couldn't be happier knowing that you remembered what I said back then and made it a core tenet of your music.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: I know exactly how you feel, Hasegawa...! What Haruka said was so amazing!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Especially since Haruka's the reason why you wanted to become an idol in the first place, Minori. You want to spread hope and make everyone believe in a better tomorrow just like her, right?

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Yeah!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: In that sense, Minori, you and Hasegawa are like two peas in a pod.

rows.Speaker: Hasegawa
rows.Line:
<Hanasato and I are...?!
B-But... I'm just...!>

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: No, please! It's not like I know how to write songs...!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Hehe.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: (Yeah, I see why we were so drawn to Hasegawa's music now...)

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
(She's just like us.
She wants genuinely wants everyone to believe in a “better tomorrow”.)

rows.Speaker: Hasegawa
rows.Line: <So... Everyone from MORE MORE JUMP!>

rows.Speaker: Hasegawa
rows.Line: <M-My songs don't get very many views and I'm not exactly a pro who can create amazing songs.>

rows.Speaker: Hasegawa
rows.Line: <But... I promise to do everything I can to spread hope to everyone who listens...! I'm really looking forward to this opportunity to work with you!>

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
Thank you!
So are we.

rows.Speaker: Hasegawa
rows.Line:
<I see...
A song that shows just how much you appreciate all the fans who've been supporting you.>

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Yes. We're here purely because of all of the support they've given us.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: For our first show on our own, we want to express our appreciation for them.

rows.Speaker: Hasegawa
rows.Line: <Understood!>

rows.Speaker: Hasegawa
rows.Line: <How about we have a slow tempo for each verse to get your feelings across while making the chorus cheerful and easy to sing together? For example...>

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Wow! Wait, you can come up with melodies just like that?!

rows.Speaker: Hasegawa
rows.Line: <Well, it's just a rough idea of what I thought it'd sound like...!>

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
But it's so wonderful.
Plus, the key you chose sounds just right and easy for us to sing.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
Yeah.
Personally, I'd kinda prefer it if it were a little higher.

rows.Speaker: Hasegawa
rows.Line:
<Yes!
Oh, but it might become difficult to sing if we raise it too high...>

rows.Speaker: Hasegawa
rows.Line: <So, if you don't mind, would it be alright if you told me more about your vocal ranges?>

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Vocal ranges?

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
How high or low your voice can go.
Most singers usually need to know how high they can sing using what kind of voice.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Without knowing that, you could end up with a song that goes higher than you expect.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Oh, okay!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: But I don't even remember my own range. The last time I checked was so long ago...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: It's been a while for me too, so there's a good chance that my range has changed...

rows.Speaker: Hasegawa
rows.Line: <In that case, would it be alright if you try using this app that makes it easy to check and sending me your results?>

rows.Speaker: Hasegawa
rows.Line: <You'll need to sing using your modal voice, using your falsetto and, if possible, a mixed voice.>

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: A mixed voice?

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: In other words, somewhere between those two vocal registers, yes...?

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Hmm... Yeah, it's kinda hard to explain...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: That's accomplished by stretching your vocal cords like you're using your falsetto but actually making all of your vocal cords vibrate.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: S-Stretch and... Vibrate...?

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: That might've just made things more confusing...

rows.Speaker: Hasegawa
rows.Line: <If there's anything that's giving you trouble, would you like it if I helped...?>

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Oh, are you sure?

rows.Speaker: Hasegawa
rows.Line: <Yes. I've studied vocal music a little bit, and I live right near Shibuya so I can meet at a moment's notice...>

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Th-Thank you so much!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
We really appreciate it.
We'll let you know once we've found a good place to record.

rows.Speaker: Hasegawa
rows.Line: <Okay. I'll be looking forward to it!>
